{{Current events|year=2021|month=12|day=20|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]
**[[2021 Democratic Republic of the Congo attacks]], [[2021 Uganda bombings]]
***The governments of [[Uganda]] and the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] reveal that they have captured 35 rebels and destroyed numerous enemy strongholds within the past week. [https://www.voanews.com/a/uganda-drc-claim-35-rebels-held-in-fighting/6361143.html (Voice of America)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**The [[Israeli Defense Forces]] report that they have arrested more than 100 members of the [[Palestinian]] [[Islamist]] organization [[Hamas]], amid a recent increase in tensions. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/israel-said-to-arrest-over-100-hamas-members-in-hebron-area-in-major-sweep/ (Times of Israel)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Three members of the [[Islamic State]] are killed in [[Faqeerabad, Peshawar|Faqeerabad]], [[Peshawar]], during an operation by the [[Pakistani police]]. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1664927/is-commander-among-three-terrorists-killed-in-peshawar (Dawn)]
*[[Internal conflict in Myanmar]]
**An investigation by the [[BBC]] discovers that a [[List of massacres in Myanmar|massacre]] of 40 [[civilian]]s took place in July, in [[Kani Township]], a [[People's Defence Force (Myanmar)|People's Defence Force]] stronghold in [[Sagaing Region]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-59699556 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Cap-Haïtien fuel tanker explosion]]
**The death toll from the fuel [[tank truck]] explosion in [[Cap-Haïtien]], [[Haiti]], six days ago rises to 90. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/12/20/haiti-truck-blast-death-toll-rises-to-90-but-still-incomplete (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Thailand]]
*****[[Thailand]]'s Food and Drug Administration approves the usage of the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine]] for children between the ages of 5 and 11 years. [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1530015/thai-agency-approves-pfizer-vaccine-for-use-in-children-age-5-11 (Inquirer)]
****Thailand reports its first locally transmitted case of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]] in a 49-year-old woman. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2234991/first-local-transmission-of-omicron-confirmed (''Bangkok Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in India]]
****It is announced that more than 85% of eligible [[Indian people|Indians]] have been partially vaccinated, and that over 55% have received both doses. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-59694246 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]] 
****[[Israel]]'s [[Cabinet of Israel|government]] agrees to ban all travel to [[Germany]], [[Italy]], [[Belgium]], [[Hungary]], [[Morocco]], [[Portugal]], [[Canada]], [[Switzerland]], [[Turkey]], and the [[United States|U.S.]] without special permission beginning on December 22 due to the spread of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/israel-bans-travel-us-omicron-concerns-rcna9323 (NBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kuwait]]
****[[Kuwait]] will require incoming travellers who fully vaccinated against [[COVID-19]] more than nine months ago to receive [[booster dose]] beginning from January 2 and also requires them to self-isolate for 10 days unless they received a negative [[PCR]] [[COVID-19 testing|test]] within 72 hours of their arrival beginning from December 26. [https://english.alarabiya.net/coronavirus/2021/12/20/Kuwait-to-make-COVID-19-vaccine-booster-compulsory-starting-January-2 (Al-Arabiya English)] [https://timesofoman.com/article/110818-10-day-home-quarantine-must-for-passengers-arriving-in-kuwait (''Times of Oman'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in France]] 
****The [[France|French]] {{Interlanguage link|Haute Autorité de santé|fr}} approves the usage of the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine]] for children between the ages of 5 and 11 years. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20211220-france-approves-pfizer-covid-19-vaccine-for-all-children-aged-5-11 (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]], [[Travel during the COVID-19 pandemic]] 
****[[Germany]] bans all travel from the [[United Kingdom]] and imposes a mandatory 14-day [[quarantine]] and proof of a negative [[PCR]] test from the previous 48 hours for German residents and citizens returning from the UK, amid the spread of the Omicron variant in Britain. [https://www.euronews.com/travel/2021/12/19/germany-tightens-restrictions-on-travel-from-uk (Euronews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[United Kingdom]] ends its travel ban on [[Angola]], [[Botswana]], [[Eswatini]], [[Lesotho]], [[Malawi]], [[Mozambique]], [[Namibia]], [[Nigeria]], [[South Africa]], [[Zambia]], and [[Zimbabwe]]. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/travel/travel-news/uk-decides-to-drop-travel-red-list-for-all-countries/as88379844.cms (Times of India)]
***[[European Union response to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****The [[European Commission]] authorizes the use of the [[Novavax COVID-19 vaccine]] after the [[European Medicines Agency]] recommended the use of the vaccine, becoming the fifth [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] to be approved for use by the [[European Union]]. [https://www.euronews.com/2021/12/20/will-novavax-be-the-fifth-covid-vaccine-approved-for-use-in-the-eu (Euronews)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Quebec]]
*****[[Quebec]] closes all bars, gyms, spas, cinemas, and concert halls as well as suspends in-person learning and mandates [[remote working]] after the province reported a record 4,857 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://globalnews.ca/news/8463635/quebec-shutting-down-covid-19-surge/amp/ (Global News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Texas]]
*****The United States reports its first confirmed death related to the Omicron variant in a unvaccinated man in his 50s in [[Harris County, Texas]] who had underlying health issues. [https://www.usnews.com/news/us/articles/2021-12-20/u-s-records-first-death-believed-related-to-omicron-variant-abc-news?context=amp (''U.S. News and World Report'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Costa Rica]]
****[[Costa Rica]] reports its first case of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]] in a eight-year-old boy who recently travelled from the United States along with his family. [https://ticotimes.net/2021/12/20/costa-rica-announces-first-case-of-omicron-variant (''Tico Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Panama]]
****[[Panama]] reports its first case of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]] in a 50-year-old person who recently travelled from South Africa. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/panama-detects-first-case-covid-19-omicron-variant-2021-12-20/ (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Bolivia]]
****[[Argentina]] donates 1 million doses of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine]] to [[Bolivia]]. [https://www.infobae.com/salud/2021/12/20/argentina-dona-a-bolivia-1-millon-de-vacunas-de-astrazeneca-contra-el-covid-19/ (''Infobae'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Colombia]]
****[[Colombia]] reports its first case of the Omicron variant in two Colombia people who travelled from the United States and a U.S. citizen who travelled from Spain. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/colombia-detects-three-cases-omicron-government-says-2021-12-21/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Russia–NATO relations]]
**[[Poland]] and [[Lithuania]] join [[Ukraine]] in calling for stronger Western [[International sanctions during the Ukrainian crisis|sanctions]] on [[Russia]], with Polish President [[Andrzej Duda]] saying that "everything must be done" to prevent a potential Russian invasion of Ukraine, and that he was "absolutely against any policy of concessions to Russia". [https://www.rferl.org/a/ukraine-poland-duda-russia-concessions/31618019.html (RFE/RL)]
**[[Assistant to the Secretary of Defense for Public Affairs|Pentagon Press Secretary]] [[John Kirby (admiral)|John Kirby]] says a small [[United States Department of Defense|Department of Defense]] team has returned from Ukraine after assessing the country's [[Anti-aircraft warfare|air defences]]. [https://www.thedrive.com/the-war-zone/43596/pentagon-team-has-returned-from-assessing-ukraines-air-defense-needs (''The Drive'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*The trial of [[Aung San Suu Kyi]] is delayed by Burmese courts until December 27. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/12/20/myanmar-court-postpones-verdict-in-aung-san-suu-kyi-trial (Al Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Human rights in Egypt]]
**Egyptian blogger and activist [[Alaa Abdel Fattah]] is sentenced to five years in prison by Egyptian authorities for spreading fake news. His family continues to protest the verdict. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/12/20/egypt-jails-leading-activist-alaa-abdel-fattah-for-five-years (Al Jazeera)]
*The [[Nagaland Legislative Assembly]] publicly demands that the [[Government of India]] repeal the [[Armed Forces Special Powers Act]], which has been in effect since 1958. This comes after [[2021 Nagaland killings|a massacre]] occurred in [[Mon district]], [[Nagaland]] on December 4. [https://www.thesangaiexpress.com/Encyc/2021/12/21/KOHIMA-Dec-20-The-Nagaland-Assembly-has-unanimously-resolved-to-demand-the-Centre-for-repeal-of.html (Sangai Express)]
